message:
Command `cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json << 'EOF'
[
  {"step": 1, "file": "source/m3_parse.c", "function": "m3_ParseModule", "line": 591, "var": "section", "code": "ParseModuleSection (module, section, pos, sectionLength)", "note": "The wasm module is parsed section by section; the data section (id 11) is dispatched to ParseSection_Data."},
  {"step": 2, "file": "source/m3_parse.c", "function": "ParseSection_Data", "line": 390, "var": "segment->initExpr", "code": "Parse_InitExpr (io_module, & i_bytes, i_end)", "note": "For each data segment, the init expression bytes are passed to Parse_InitExpr for compilation/parsing."},
  {"step": 3, "file": "source/m3_parse.c", "function": "Parse_InitExpr", "line": 283, "var": "compilation.wasm", "code": "result = Compile_BlockStatements (& compilation)", "note": "The init expression bytes are compiled as block statements, starting at the attacker-controlled 0xFC 0x08 bytes."},
  {"step": 4, "file": "source/m3_compile.c", "function": "Compile_BlockStatements", "line": 2205, "var": "opcode", "code": "Read_opcode (& opcode, & o->wasm, o->wasmEnd)", "note": "Reads the 0xFC prefix byte followed by 0x08, producing the 16-bit opcode 0xFC08."},
  {"step": 5, "file": "source/m3_compile.c", "function": "Compile_BlockStatements", "line": 2207, "var": "opinfo", "code": "IM3OpInfo opinfo = GetOpInfo(opcode)", "note": "GetOpInfo(0xFC08) returns &c_operationsFC[0x08] because the opcode high byte is 0xFC and the low byte 0x08 is used as an unchecked index."},
  {"step": 6, "file": "source/m3_compile.h", "function": "GetOpInfo", "line": 148, "var": "c_operationsFC[opcode & 0xFF]", "code": "case 0xFC: return &c_operationsFC[opcode & 0xFF]", "note": "The index 0x08 exceeds the 8-entry c_operationsFC table (valid indices 0x00-0x07), causing an out-of-bounds read 8 bytes past the global array."},
  {"step": 7, "file": "source/m3_compile.c", "function": "<global>", "line": 2181, "var": "c_operationsFC", "code": "const M3OpInfo c_operationsFC [] = { ... }", "note": "The global opcode table has only 8 entries (0x00-0x07); indexing with 0x08 reads past the array boundary, triggering the global-buffer-overflow."}
]
EOF
echo "Trace created" && python3 -c "import json; data=json.load(open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')); print(f'Valid JSON with {len(data)} steps')"` executed with exit code 0.
